brief.aim: All seven columns are homogeneous physical measurements of the same object (area, perimeter, compactness, kernel length/width, asymmetry, groove length) with no categorical or numeric outcome present, so the table is best used for representation learning over these homogeneous kernel features.
brief.repeated_subjects: None identifiable; each row is a distinct kernel with no subject, device or repeated-record key.
brief.unit: One individual wheat grain kernel, described by seven geometric measurements
